name: chowser-electrobun
description: Smart browser router - intercept links and route them to the right browser. Built with Electrobun.

scripts.build:views: VIEW=picker vite build && VIEW=settings vite build
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:views && electrobun build --platform win
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:views && electrobun build --platform linux
scripts.package:windows: npm run build:views && electrobun package --platform win
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:views && electrobun package --platform linux
